svg.title: Sysvia 2.3.5 — extended monitors and faster Mac screen encoding
svg.desc: A close editorial photograph of one landscape monitor and one silver laptop on a walnut desk. The monitor shows a deep forest-green branded wallpaper and the laptop shows a complementary pale sky-blue wallpaper, each with the original Sysvia mark. Small release branding sits above the hardware. Warm daylight, a slim keyboard and mouse, and no decorative clutter.
